**Problem / Motivation**
A clear and concise description of the problem or motivation. Ex: When defending against X, it is difficult to...

**Proposed solution**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Alternatives considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

**Defensive-scope confirmation**
Please confirm this request aligns with the project rules in `CONTRIBUTING.md`:
- [ ] This feature is **strictly defensive** (no offensive or "hack-back" capability, no outbound third-party network calls, fail-open guarantee preserved).
- [ ] This feature can be implemented using the **Python standard library only** (or as a clearly gated optional extra).

**Additional context**
Add any other context, examples, or references about the feature request here. Do not include live credentials, production evidence ledgers, or personal data.
